It's a beautiful and meaningful name that signifies the reality and presence of things, including the presence of the Almighty Allah in our lives. It's also a name that can evoke a sense of strength, reality, and even resilience. For many Muslim parents, naming their child Mawjudah serves as a reminder of the divine presence and reality in their everyday lives.

It reminds us that everything around us, including ourselves, has a divine presence and purpose.
